stories.title: Hoax bomb threats disrupt European air travel
stories.summary: At least 34 flights across Europe were disrupted this week by a series of hoax bomb threats. Multiple aircraft were forced to make emergency landings for security inspections, though no explosives were found. Authorities are investigating the coordinated nature of the alerts, which affected over a dozen carriers.

stories.title: European flights face wave of bomb threats
stories.summary: More than 30 European flights faced security alerts or diversions this week, with at least 25 bomb threats reported on Thursday alone. Ryanair was the hardest hit airline, with eight incidents. The disruptions have left passengers and civil aviation authorities managing a sudden increase in security concerns.

stories.title: Southwest Airlines ranks last for punctuality
stories.summary: Southwest Airlines was the least punctual of North America's 10 leading airlines last month, with 68.9 percent of flights arriving on time. Almost one in three completed flights arrived at least 15 minutes late. Delta Air Lines led the rankings with an 86.9 percent on-time performance rate.

stories.title: Experts clarify limits of AI in aviation
stories.summary: Airline executives in India report that AI is being used to collate training data and enhance instruction quality. Air India executive Manish Uppal confirmed that pilot-less operations are not in the future.
